feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: German chancellor stands his ground after his party loses in state elections
entry.summary: German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells "disaster" for the political center, but assured the public he'd push ahead with his federal agenda of tax and welfare reforms.

entry.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
entry.summary: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

entry.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
entry.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

entry.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
entry.summary: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

entry.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
entry.summary: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

entry.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
entry.summary: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
entry.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

entry.title: Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas
entry.summary: The Department of Homeland Security said Monday it was leading the investigation into the officer involved in a shooting of "an illegal alien from Venezuela" during an operation in Austin, Texas.

entry.title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania
entry.summary: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.

entry.title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
entry.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains.
